moneyInvariant.rationale: free liquidity + collateral held + unclaimed fees are the only ETH the contract may hold. reservedLiquidity is already inside totalLiquidity but has been disbursed to borrowers, so it is excluded. The spec's original rule-12 wording (since amended in docs/INTEGRATION_SPEC.md to the identity above) read totalLiquidity + accumulatedCollateral + treasuryBalance + DEAD_SHARES, which omits -reservedLiquidity and adds 1 wei the bootstrap deposit does not create; suite 13 measures both deviations exactly, in wei, so the amendment is reproducible rather than asserted on trust.
